# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: RepoMiner Visual & UX Alignment

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of the visual-alignment requirements.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all existing primary routes and the allowed navigation destinations explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are Home metrics limited to existing data and are omission/unavailable outcomes defined when data cannot be derived? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are existing CRUD, GitLab credential, scope, author, and scheduling functions all represented in the five-step configuration experience? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Are execution list fields, existing filters/actions, and all four execution-detail tabs covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 Are Feature 011/012 commit-diff states and interactions all explicitly preserved? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are the Home metric definitions and their time window objectively defined, including empty and active-only windows? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Plan §Home]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it clear which Authors controls remain active and which future repository/branch policy controls must be unavailable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008–FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the content and interpretation of configuration schedule summaries defined without introducing recurrence changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Read-only presentation projections]
- [ ] CHK009 Is “reasonable tablet/narrow viewport” adequately bounded by supported layout outcomes and representative validation widths? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018, SC-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do reference images remain subordinate to the specification and existing behavior when decorative details conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the Authors reference's per-scope controls consistently described as non-functional while the existing global allowed-author behavior remains intact? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008–FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Do read-only dashboard/list projections preserve existing API behavior and avoid implying new persistence or mining semantics? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019–FR-020]
- [ ] CHK013 Are status labels/visuals required to preserve current meanings and communicate status beyond color across every affected screen? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016–FR-017]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can each success criterion be assessed from observable user-visible behavior or data provenance without relying on invented metrics? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-008]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the required viewport classes and controlled-overflow outcome clear enough to assess responsive behavior? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the visual-review criterion require review of all supplied references while allowing intentional differences required by existing behavior? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are empty, loading, error, and retry states addressed for screens whose data comes from existing APIs? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, FR-016, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are unavailable historical scope selections, credential secrecy, stale edits, and partially completed execution results covered as preservation cases? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are narrow-screen table/diff overflow and split-view preservation addressed without introducing a different mobile product? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, Edge Cases]

## Accessibility and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK020 Are keyboard navigation, visible focus, form labels/errors, semantic tables, dialog focus, contrast, and non-color status communication specified for affected workflows? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the allowed read-only API projections and their dependence on existing persisted data explicitly documented without authorizing migrations? [Dependency, Spec §FR-020, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the ten reference images identified and mapped to current screens, with sample values excluded from requirements and production data? [Dependency, Spec §FR-023, Plan §Approved Reference Images]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline and link to relevant resources as needed.
